positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Developing new features and web applications for ESG to support utilities and statewide trusts to manage their energy efficiency program data.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Babel Dabble is a realtime competitive calligraphy platform that makes it fun to master writing Chinese characters. Players can compete or practice individually when no Internet connectivity is available. In addition, it provides a learning management system for teachers to create assignments for students to complete by using the same interactive writing canvas used during competition. 

• Developed the custom vocabulary feature for users to create lists of their own Chinese characters to compete with. Form for user to create a new list was built with AngularJS. Built server-side code using ASP.NET Web API 2 on .NET Framework 4.6 that feeds the selected words to WebSockets via SignalR for real-time gameplay use.
• Implemented customer charge and subscription payment functionality upon creating a new account. Payment form was built with Stripe integration and React using ECMAScript 2015 (ES6).
• Designed and implemented tables and stored procedures in SQL Server 2016, including the JSON reading and writing functionality.

positions.title: QC Analyst
positions.description:
Reported and reviewed data and chromatograms from HPLC analyses of drug products to assist in the evaluation of their chemical ingredients, including determining the identity, strength, quality, and purity of active pharmaceutical ingredients and possible contaminants or unknowns. Prepared experiments according to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and experimental study protocols.

Analyzed drug samples containing Schedule II controlled substances in compliance to FDA and DEA regulations. Determined the identity and composition of these samples by calculating and reporting the resulting data, and then reporting my conclusions on both paper documentation and shared management software.
